about.text: The Levantine strained yogurt, taken further than Greek yogurt. In Lebanon and other Middle Eastern countries, set yogurt is drained in cloth bags until it reaches about 23–25% solids and 9–11% fat. Commercial labneh keeps for two to three weeks in the fridge.

picture.author: Leslie Seaton from Seattle, WA, USA

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.label: salt, strain
how.text: Labneh is yoghurt that has been salted and then drained of whey in cloth, which concentrates the protein into a thick, tangy spread. Codex lists it as a concentrated fermented milk, with at least 5.6 % protein.

steps.name: strain
steps.note: In a cloth bag or cheesecloth, overnight.

processing.text: Industrially it is centrifuged or ultrafiltered instead.
